title: Fretbound: Ear Training Roguelike
author: Alive-Stable-7254
selftext:
Bored of the same ear training games? Like fretted instruments? Want to see the world? Check out Fretbound! I made it, but I think it's really fun. I wish I was playing it right now instead of writing the paragraph! It's early access! It's free! It's fun!

I gotta go to work. See you later! 

https://hausway777.itch.io/fretbound

comments.author: LowerMiddleClassMan
comments.body: If your post is this low effort, why would I not assume the same about your game?  And why would I possibly click on that link?

replies.author: Alive-Stable-7254
replies.body: I don't post much so I don't have a lot of instincts about what works (plus, I was already behind getting to work and my daughter wanted my attention). But, you are right, it could have been higher effort. Next time, I'll add a video or screenshot. Thank you for the feedback!

comments.author: Oscill_8
comments.body: The post describes the game, and the game seems pretty high effort. I’d check it out if you play a fretted instrument.

replies.author: Alive-Stable-7254
replies.body: Thank you! It has got me thinking about shapes on the neck in a way I haven't since I was a teenager in lessons.
